peripheral_scope.review: Official C145 schematic and Tab5 manual give one shared P4/expander/audio/SD wiring map for all three published panel assemblies. The pinned BSP supplies distinct panel timings/init and GPIO23 handling, selected by the touch controller. Unknown panel firmware fails closed. No factory-binary pin inference used. INA226 0x41/5 mOhm shunt, BMI270 0x68 and RX8130CE 0x32 use the same published shared I2C1 map; identity and configuration readback precede telemetry. The RTC backup control matches the fitted rechargeable supply. Charger/rail controls stay excluded. USB-A J10 and its masked 0x44/P3 enable are additionally scoped by the pinned USB-controller schematic/BSP review. USB-C Serial/JTAG remains independent. User subsequently approved the exact C6 radio scope and requested battery charging. These narrowly scoped authorizations extend the prior 0.44 scope.

display.reset: PI4IOE5V6408 0x43 P4, release as input pull-up

sensors.power: INA226 at 0x41, 5 mOhm shunt, voltage-based 2S estimate
sensors.clock: RX8130CE 0x32: read/init plus explicit UTC calendar write 0x10..0x16, VLF-only W0C 0x1D=0xBD after calendar readback, and clearing a pre-existing STOP bit at 0x1E after valid calendar; no alarms, timers, clock-output or offset configuration.

usb_host.connector: J10 dedicated USB-A; native HS peripheral 0
usb_host.power_enable: PI4IOE5V6408 0x44/P3 active high; U27 MT9700 current-limited switch
usb_host.driver_scope: Masked direction/latch/high-impedance operations preserve every other expander bit; rollback powers off
usb_host.user_scope: Requested native Xbox-compatible USB controller support in Core OS and approved the complete 0.43 update
usb_host.acceptance: USB host startup may be observed; no controller model is hardware-qualified by this install

c6_local_multiplayer.scope: User explicitly approved C6 Bluetooth and local Wi-Fi Host/Join on 2026-10-05. Shared I2C1 GPIO31/32, masked expander 0x44/P0 WLAN 3.3V enable only; SDMMC slot1 GPIO12 CLK,13 CMD,11/10/9/8 D0-D3 at initial 10 MHz, GPIO15 C6 EN high-low-high reset. No C6 flash writes or unrelated pins/rails. Exact P4 artifact and backed-up unit must pass the installation guard.

battery_charger_500ma.basis: User confirms attached batteries and requests fixing charging; pinned official M5Unified and C145 schematic in third_party/tab5-sensors.json.
battery_charger_500ma.scope: Shared I2C1 GPIO31/32, expander 0x44 P7 CHG_EN, P5 QC disabled, P6 charge status input. 500 mA selection only; preserve all other pins. Exact-artifact guarded install required.
